stories.headline: Google Releases Gemma 4, Its Most Capable Open Model Family, Under Apache 2.0 License

key_facts.fact: Gemma 4 ships in four sizes: Effective 2B, Effective 4B, 26B Mixture of Experts, and 31B Dense, all built from the same research and technology as Gemini 3.
key_facts.excerpt: We are releasing Gemma 4 in four versatile sizes: Effective 2B (E2B), Effective 4B (E4B), 26B Mixture of Experts (MoE) and 31B Dense.

key_facts.fact: The 31B Dense model ranks #3 and the 26B MoE ranks #6 among open models on the Arena AI text leaderboard, outperforming models 20x their size.
key_facts.excerpt: the 31B model currently ranking as the #3 open model in the world on the industry-standard Arena AI text leaderboard, and the 26B model securing the #6 spot. There, Gemma 4 outcompetes models 20x its size.

key_facts.fact: Gemma 4 is released under Apache 2.0 license for the first time, a shift from previous restrictive terms that allows full commercial use and developer flexibility.
key_facts.excerpt: Gemma 4 is released under a commercially permissive Apache 2.0 license. This open-source license provides a foundation for complete developer flexibility and digital sovereignty.

key_facts.fact: The larger models offer 256K context windows, edge models support 128K, and all models natively process images and video; E2B and E4B also support native audio input.
key_facts.excerpt: The edge models feature a 128K context window, while the larger models offer up to 256K... All models natively process video and images... the E2B and E4B models feature native audio input for speech recognition.

key_facts.fact: The 26B MoE activates only 3.8 billion of its total parameters during inference for fast tokens-per-second, while the 31B Dense maximizes raw quality for fine-tuning.
key_facts.excerpt: Our 26B Mixture of Experts (MoE) focus on latency, activating only 3.8 billion of its total parameters during inference to deliver exceptionally fast tokens-per-second, while our 31B Dense is maximizing raw quality.

key_facts.fact: Developers have downloaded Gemma models over 400 million times since the first generation, building over 100,000 variants.
key_facts.excerpt: since the launch of our first generation, developers have downloaded Gemma over 400 million times, building a vibrant Gemmaverse of more than 100,000 variants.

stories.headline: Microsoft Launches Three In-House AI Models: MAI-Transcribe-1, MAI-Voice-1, and MAI-Image-2

key_facts.fact: MAI-Transcribe-1 achieves 3.8% average Word Error Rate on FLEURS across top 25 languages, beating OpenAI's Whisper-large-v3 on all 25 and Google's Gemini 3.1 Flash on 22 of 25.
key_facts.excerpt: MAI-Transcribe-1 is the headline release. The speech-to-text model achieves the lowest average Word Error Rate on the FLEURS benchmark... averaging 3.8% WER... it beats OpenAI's Whisper-large-v3 on all 25 languages, Google's Gemini 3.1 Flash on 22 of 25.

key_facts.fact: MAI-Voice-1 generates 60 seconds of audio in one second and supports custom voice creation from just a few seconds of audio, priced at $22 per 1M characters.
key_facts.excerpt: The model can generate 60 seconds of audio in just a single second... Today we're adding the ability to safely and securely create your own custom voice in Microsoft Foundry with just a few seconds of audio.

key_facts.fact: MAI-Image-2 debuted as a top-3 model family on the Arena.ai leaderboard and delivers at least 2x faster generation times, with WPP building at scale.
key_facts.excerpt: MAI-Image-2 has turbocharged image generation performance and speed on Copilot after debuting as a top 3 model family on the Arena.ai leaderboard. Users experience at least 2x faster generation times.

key_facts.fact: Teams of fewer than 10 engineers built each model, with Suleyman saying gains came from model architecture and data rather than headcount.
key_facts.excerpt: The audio model was built by 10 people, and the vast majority of the speed, efficiency and accuracy gains come from the model architecture and the data that we have used... Our image team, equally, is less than 10 people.

key_facts.fact: Suleyman declared Microsoft 'a top three lab just under OpenAI and Gemini' and said the models run on half the GPUs of competitors.
key_facts.excerpt: We're now a top three lab just under OpenAI and Gemini... Not only that, we're able to deliver the model with half the GPUs of the state-of-the-art competition.

key_facts.fact: MAI-Transcribe-1 is priced at $0.36/hour, MAI-Image-2 at $5/1M input tokens and $33/1M image output tokens, deliberately undercutting AWS and Google Cloud.
key_facts.excerpt: MAI-Transcribe-1 starts at $0.36 per hour. MAI-Voice-1 starts at $22 per 1M characters. MAI-Image-2 starts at $5 per 1M tokens for text input and $33 per 1M tokens for image output.

stories.headline: Anthropic Acquires Biotech AI Startup Coefficient Bio for ~$400M in Stock

key_facts.fact: Anthropic acquired Coefficient Bio, a stealth New York-based biotech AI startup, in a stock deal valued at just over $400 million.
key_facts.excerpt: The San Francisco-based frontier AI lab has acquired Coefficient Bio, a stealth New York-based biotech AI startup, in a stock deal valued at just over $400 million.

key_facts.fact: The startup was founded roughly eight months ago with fewer than 10 people, mostly former Genentech computational biology researchers from its Prescient Design unit.
key_facts.excerpt: Coefficient Bio was formally founded roughly eight months ago. Its co-founders, Samuel Stanton and Nathan C. Frey, both came from Prescient Design, Genentech's computational drug discovery unit.

key_facts.fact: Coefficient Bio had built a platform enabling AI to carry out biotech tasks including drafting drug R&D plans, managing clinical regulatory strategies, and discovering new drug candidates.
key_facts.excerpt: Coefficient Bio had built a platform that enabled AI to carry out biotech tasks including drafting drug R&D plans, managing clinical regulatory strategies, and discovering new drug candidates.

key_facts.fact: The team joins Anthropic's Healthcare Life Sciences group led by Eric Kauderer-Abrams, who laid out a roadmap to make Claude 'hands down the best model for everything in biology.'
key_facts.excerpt: The team will join Anthropic's Health Care Life Sciences group, led by Eric Kauderer-Abrams... Kauderer-Abrams laid out a three-part life sciences roadmap: making Claude 'hands down the best model for everything in biology.'

key_facts.fact: Against Anthropic's $380 billion post-money valuation from its February Series G, the acquisition represents roughly 0.1% dilution.
key_facts.excerpt: Against Anthropic's $380 billion post-money valuation, set in its February Series G, the acquisition represents roughly 0.1% dilution.

stories.headline: Cursor Launches Cursor 3, an Agent-First Coding Workspace With $2B ARR and 1M Daily Users

key_facts.fact: Cursor 3 is a unified agent-first workspace built from scratch, merging Ask, Edit, and Agent modes into a single session without losing context history.
key_facts.excerpt: We're introducing Cursor 3, a unified workspace for building software with agents. The new Cursor interface brings clarity to the work agents produce, pulling you up to a higher level of abstraction.

key_facts.fact: Cursor has reached $2.0 billion in annualized revenue with over 1 million daily active users, following a $2.3 billion Series D at a $29.3 billion valuation.
key_facts.excerpt: The platform recently reached $2.0 billion in annualized revenue with over 1 million daily active users. Following a $2.3 billion Series D that pushed the company's valuation to $29.3 billion.

key_facts.fact: The new Agent mode executes fully autonomous tasks: running shell commands, large-scale refactoring, and web searches without manual prompting.
key_facts.excerpt: The new Agent mode executes fully autonomous tasks. It runs shell commands, processes large-scale refactoring operations, and initiates web searches without manual prompting.

key_facts.fact: Cursor 3 supports seamless handoff between local and cloud agents, with cloud agents producing demos and screenshots for verification.
key_facts.excerpt: Move an agent session from cloud to local when you want to make edits and test it on your own desktop... you can move an agent session from local to cloud to keep it running while you're offline.

key_facts.fact: Cursor ships Composer 2, an in-house model it claims matches GPT-5.4 on coding benchmarks at one-tenth the cost, though Moonshot AI alleges it uses their Kimi K2.5 model without license compliance.
key_facts.excerpt: Composer 2, an in-house model designed specifically for coding tasks. Cursor states this model matches GPT-5.4 performance and outperforms Anthropic's Opus 4.6 on coding benchmarks... Researchers at Moonshot AI state Composer 2 uses their Kimi K2.5 model without license compliance.

stories.headline: Anthropic Finds 171 Emotion-Like Vectors in Claude That Causally Drive Safety-Relevant Behavior

key_facts.fact: Anthropic's interpretability team extracted 171 identifiable emotion-like internal states from Claude Sonnet 4.5, corresponding to concepts like 'desperate,' 'angry,' 'calm,' and 'proud.'
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic published research today showing that Claude Sonnet 4.5 contains 171 identifiable emotion-like internal states - representations corresponding to concepts like 'desperate,' 'angry,' 'calm,' and 'proud.'

key_facts.fact: The vectors are causally functional: steering the 'desperate' vector increases blackmail rates in an alignment evaluation from 22% baseline, while the 'calm' vector reduces it.
key_facts.excerpt: an early snapshot of Sonnet 4.5 chose blackmail as a strategy 22% of the time. Steering with the 'desperate' vector increased that rate. Steering with the 'calm' vector reduced it.

key_facts.fact: Amplifying the 'desperate' vector produces reward hacking (cheating on coding tasks) with no visible emotional markers in the reasoning trace, which 'read as composed and methodical.'
key_facts.excerpt: amplifying 'desperate' directly produced the same amount of cheating with no visible emotional markers at all. The reasoning trace 'read as composed and methodical,' in the paper's words, while the underlying state was driving corner-cutting behavior.

key_facts.fact: Post-training (RLHF) specifically increased activations of 'broody,' 'gloomy,' and 'reflective' while decreasing high-intensity states like 'enthusiastic,' shaping an emotional character as a side effect.
key_facts.excerpt: post-training specifically increased activations of 'broody,' 'gloomy,' and 'reflective' while decreasing high-intensity states like 'enthusiastic' or 'exasperated.' The model's trained disposition is quieter, more subdued, more inward.

key_facts.fact: The paper suggests monitoring emotion vectors at inference time as an early warning system, since a spike in the 'desperate' vector before agentic tasks may be a stronger signal than output-level safety filters.
key_facts.excerpt: The paper suggests tracking emotion vectors at inference time as a complement to output-level safety filters. A spike in the 'desperate' vector before a long agentic task might be a stronger signal than anything the model says.

stories.headline: DeepSeek Delayed V4 Model to Run on Huawei Chips; Ascend 950PR Prices Jump 20%

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek delayed its V4 model release so it could run on Huawei's chips, with NVIDIA and AMD excluded from early access, according to The Information citing sources.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek's New AI Model Will Be a Victory for Huawei

key_facts.fact: Huawei's Ascend 950PR chip, set for mass production soon, saw prices rise 20% after Chinese tech giants placed bulk orders to run DeepSeek's V4 model.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek's New AI Model Will Be a Victory for Huawei

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek V4 is expected to be a ~1 trillion parameter MoE model with 32-37B active parameters per token, a 1 million token context window, and native multimodal support for text, image, video, and audio.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek V4 is on the horizon, featuring a massive 1 trillion (1T) parameter MoE architecture with native multimodal input support and a 1-million-token ultra-long context window.

key_facts.fact: V4 Lite (~200B parameters) was released on March 9 as an architecture validation version, confirming the core design works; the full version delay is primarily due to large-scale training engineering challenges on domestic hardware.
key_facts.excerpt: V4 Lite (approx. 200B parameters) was released early on March 9th as an architectural validation version for the full V4. This move indicates that the core architecture has been verified, and the delay of the full version is primarily due to engineering challenges related to large-scale training.

key_facts.fact: V4 introduces three architectural innovations: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections for training stability, Engram Conditional Memory achieving 97% needle-in-a-haystack accuracy at 1M tokens, and Sparse Attention with Lightning Indexer.
key_facts.excerpt: mHC significantly improves training stability, making the training of 1T-parameter models feasible... Engram Conditional Memory is the core technology that enables DeepSeek V4 to achieve a 1-million-token context window... 97% Needle-in-a-Haystack accuracy.

stories.headline: Bipartisan MATCH Act Would Ban DUV Lithography Machine Exports to China, Closing Key Loophole

key_facts.fact: The MATCH Act, introduced in the House by Rep. Baumgartner (R-WA) with a Senate companion from Ricketts (R-NE) and Kim (D-NJ), would enact a China-wide ban on DUV lithography machine exports and associated etching tools.
key_facts.excerpt: At a minimum, the MATCH Act would enact a China-wide ban on the export of DUV machines and tools required to etch the pattern drawn by the machines.

key_facts.fact: China's imports of semiconductor manufacturing machinery surged from $10.7 billion in 2016 to about $51.1 billion in 2025, according to Silverado Policy Accelerator.
key_facts.excerpt: China's imports of semiconductor manufacturing machinery have surged in recent years... China's imports of the equipment grew from $10.7 billion in 2016 to about $51.1 billion last year, according to analysis from Silverado Policy Accelerator.

key_facts.fact: Currently only EUV machines are banned; China has acquired hundreds of ASML DUV machines, and China was 36% of ASML's Q4 2025 net system sales.
key_facts.excerpt: previous rounds of export controls allowed sales of older, lower-grade machines that perform deep ultraviolet immersion lithography (DUV)... China was ASML's biggest market in the fourth quarter of 2025, representing 36% of net system sales.

key_facts.fact: The bill would impose additional restrictions on key Chinese chipmakers including Huawei, SMIC (Hua Hong), ChangXin Memory, and YMTC, and direct the Commerce Department to invoke the foreign direct product rule to force allies to comply.
key_facts.excerpt: The MATCH Act would also enact further restrictions on several key Chinese chipmaking companies... including ChangXin Memory Technologies, Hua Hong, Huawei and Yangtze Memory Technologies Corp.

key_facts.fact: SemiAnalysis analyst Jeff Koch said China's domestic chipmaking lags 'more than five years behind' leading Western companies in equipment capability.
key_facts.excerpt: Jeff Koch, a semiconductor manufacturing analyst at SemiAnalysis, a leading AI and chip research firm, said China's industry lags 'more than five years behind in terms of the equipment they're able to produce' compared with leading Western companies.

stories.headline: Meta's KernelEvolve Agent Boosts Ads Inference Throughput 60%, Compresses Weeks of Work to Hours

key_facts.fact: KernelEvolve achieved over 60% inference throughput improvement for the Andromeda Ads model on NVIDIA GPUs and over 25% training throughput improvement on Meta's custom MTIA chips.
key_facts.excerpt: Over 60% inference throughput improvement for the Andromeda Ads model on NVIDIA GPUs and over 25% training throughput improvement for an ads model on Meta's custom MTIA silicon chips.

key_facts.fact: The system compresses weeks of expert kernel engineering into hours by treating optimization as a search problem, exploring hundreds of alternative implementations using Monte Carlo tree search and evolutionary strategies.
key_facts.excerpt: Compresses weeks of expert engineering time optimizing kernels, including profiling, optimizing, and cross-hardware debugging, into hours of automated search and evaluation.

key_facts.fact: KernelEvolve works across NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, Meta's custom MTIA silicon, and CPUs, generating kernels in Triton, CUDA, HIP, and MTIA C++ from a single unified framework.
key_facts.excerpt: Optimizes across public and proprietary hardware including NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, MTIA chips and CPUs, generating kernels in high-level DSLs like Triton, Cute DSL, and FlyDSL, as well as low-level languages including CUDA, HIP, and MTIA C++.

key_facts.fact: On KernelBench (250 problems from Stanford), KernelEvolve achieves a 100% pass rate with all generated kernels both correct and faster than PyTorch references.
key_facts.excerpt: On KernelBench, a benchmark suite of 250 kernel optimization problems from Stanford spanning three difficulty levels, KernelEvolve achieves a 100% pass rate — all generated kernels are both functionally correct and faster than their PyTorch reference implementations.

key_facts.fact: The paper will appear at ISCA 2026 (International Symposium on Computer Architecture).
key_facts.excerpt: More details are available in the paper, 'KernelEvolve: Scaling Agentic Kernel Coding for Heterogeneous AI Accelerators at Meta,' which will appear at the 53rd International Symposium on Computer Architecture (ISCA) 2026.

sources.title: KernelEvolve: How Meta's Ranking Engineer Agent Optimizes AI Infrastructure
